thread:
alex.k: Heads-up: seeing a small but consistent tail latency bump on long sequences after the kernel reorder PR landed (~5-8% p95/p99). Can owners chime in?

maya.r: thanks for flagging. I merged reorder PR (D4521) yesterday. It should improve GPU utilization for short sequences; didn't expect long-seq regressions.

sean_h: linking the perf run: https://ci.redwood/test/4521/compare — p50 unchanged, p95 +6%, p99 +8 for seq_len>=2048. Raw flamegraphs attached in the job.

maya.r: looking now. initial suspicion: the new kernel switches some matmul layouts; might degrade KV hit pattern for large KV sizes.

alex.k: cc @maya.r @sean_h also saw more small GC spikes in runtime logs around the same timestamp. Could be KV cache churn.

sean_h: I dug into logs: KV eviction counts spike when batch_window_ms bumps up due to batching heuristics combining long requests. If the kernel reorder increased per-token time, batch windows elongated -> larger batches -> more KV churn.

brynn_pm: we need to know impact on the milestone: is this a showstopper for the continuous-batching rollout next week?

maya.r: not a showstopper yet. If we can tweak batching config on the canary and validate, we can keep rollout. Proposed quick experiment: force max_batch_size=64 and batch_window_ms=8 on canary hosts and compare.

alex.k: sounds reasonable. who will own the canary tweak + perf run?

sean_h: I can own the canary test. Plan: deploy config override to canary group, run 6h perf, capture p50/p95/p99 + KV eviction metrics. PR: D4538 (canary config override).

maya.r: I'll prepare a patch to revert the matmul layout change if the canary shows regressions. D4540 is the revert-ready branch (no runtime churn).

brynn_pm: ok assign owners: canary test -> @sean_h, kernel revert readiness -> @maya.r. Target: get results within 24 hours so we can decide for Friday rollout.

alex.k: also pinging infra: @ops-bot can you create a canary group named cbatch-kv-canary and pin it to the next canary window? :eyes:

ops-bot: Canary group cbatch-kv-canary created and scheduled for the next canary window at 03:00 UTC. Link: https://infra.redwood/canaries/cbatch-kv-canary :white_check_mark:

sean_h: started the experiment (D4538) now. quick note: test harness will run both long and short seq workloads to catch regressions across distributions.

maya.r: thanks. I'll be on standby to cut D4540 if we see >7% p95 regression.

alex.k: extra ask: leave a short note in the sprint board under "continuous-batching" with outcome + decision and mark blocked/unblocked accordingly.

brynn_pm: will do. tagging this thread for asynchronous updates — please drop final numbers here when done. :memo: :shipit:
